catalog_source.integration: independent fixed-rule rebuild; source code is not executed or copied

source_causal_confirmed.body_reference: absolute value of expanding signed mean of open minus close, including the completed star bar
source_causal_confirmed.confirmation: next high no greater than star high and next close no greater than star close

normalized_confirmed.body_reference: expanding mean absolute body divided by close, including the completed star bar
normalized_confirmed.confirmation: next high no greater than star high and next close no greater than star close

normalized_unconfirmed.body_reference: expanding mean absolute body divided by close, including the completed star bar

position_rules.overlap: one position per asset; ignore new stars while already short
position_rules.reference_price: completed star close, matching the source
position_rules.exit: flat after a completed close moves strictly more than 5 percent from the star close or seven sessions have elapsed from the star
position_rules.confirmation_stop_collision: do not enter if the confirmation bar already triggers the source close stop

portfolio.turnover: full L1 change across traded assets from drifted holdings

promotion_gates.primary_performance: positive annual return, Sharpe above 0.5, and drawdown no worse than -25 percent under the primary scenario
promotion_gates.stress: positive full-period and both later-window annual returns under the stress scenario
promotion_gates.controls: candidate Sharpe exceeds every stale, inverted, and permuted control under the primary scenario
promotion_gates.dependence: absolute correlation no greater than 0.80 to core and trend
promotion_gates.blend: 80/20 core blend improves Sharpe with no worse drawdown and familywise paired lower Sharpe difference above zero
